# Question: strongest canonical-fitting shortcut

The strongest plausible shortcut is **rank the objects by occupied area
ascending**, then repaint them 2, 3, and 4. It is simple, geometric, and fits all
4/4 canonical pairs because every canonical object is a solid rectangle whose
occupied area is ordered the same way as its contour-cell count. Bounding-box
area and bounding-box perimeter also fit 4/4, but occupied area is the most
direct rival to the baseline generator's old size semantics.

## Exact disagreement input

This 12×20 grid was emitted by generator `3.1.1`, SHA-256
`bdab70b6181c982eab40837a5659fea7c58a2760032be5a530843dd155defb0d`,
with seed `77`, sample index `1`, and exact overrides
`scene_profile=area_inversion`, `palette_mode=distinct`:

```text
00000500000000000000
00000500000000000000
00000500000000000000
00000500000000000000
00000500000000000000
00000000000000000000
00000000000000000000
77777777777777000000
00000000000000000000
66666000000000000000
66666000000000000000
66666000000000000000
```

The objects in intended contour order are:

| input color / top-left | area | contour cells | intended rank color |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| 5 at `(0,5)` | 5 | 5 | 2 |
| 6 at `(9,0)` | 15 | 12 | 3 |
| 7 at `(7,0)` | 14 | 14 | 4 |

The occupied-area rival instead orders areas `5 < 14 < 15`, assigning color 3
to the long color-7 line and color 4 to the color-6 rectangle. Thus it disagrees
on both of those objects.

## How it was checked

I saved the exact grid, Python mirror, rival output, and measurements under
`checks/question-area-v311/`. Then I ran the supported Racket application:

```text
python3 run_with_racket.py python3 -m arcpuzzles apply 901c6034f67e \
  --input ../checks/question-area-v311/input.json \
  --out ../checks/question-area-v311/racket.json
```

The executed rule hash was `3646fc9eedbe`. The Racket output exactly matches the
Python contour mirror and differs from the occupied-area rival. The complete
hash-bound record is `checks/question-area-v311/reproducer.json`.

## Does the proposed generator emit such cases?

Yes. `area_inversion` is an advertised exact profile and one slot in every
three-example default schedule. In the final source-bound census, the occupied-
area competitor was refuted in 100/100 lessons in each of easy, medium, and hard.
